caption: The drawing depicts a single, sleeveless vest laid flat against a plain, off-white background. The vest is dark brown or black with a subtle sheen, featuring a faint paisley pattern in a lighter shade, with occasional small red or pink accents within the pattern. The lapels are broad and fold over at the front, with the inside lining visible at the collar in a contrasting light tan or beige color. There are two narrow, horizontal pockets on each side of the vest front, placed symmetrically and parallel to the bottom hem. The buttons of the vest are not visible, as the front overlaps neatly and obscures them. The paper on which the vest is depicted contains a faint signature reading “S. Swanson” in the bottom right corner.
title: Waistcoat
